short.lead: This builds option A. On a phone, the writing in the jotter gets the whole first line. The 'To:' stamp (which picks where the thought goes) and the Add button move to a second line below it, with the stamp on the left and Add on the right. It is one small style change in `app/css/app.css`. It applies at the phone width where the jotter already stretches across the screen. On a computer nothing changes.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it does.
items: Lay the jotter out on two lines (#245)

The change applies only at phone width. A long project name on the stamp gets the spare room on the second line instead of being cut short. The browser check confirms two things, in light and dark mode. On a phone, the writing spans the jotter. On a computer, the writing, the stamp and Add all stay on one line. Then I open a pull request for you to test.
